outcome_evidence: The upper drawer is initially closed (frame 0, left_ego_image). The robot approaches and aligns with its handle (frames 25–75, left_ego_image and wrist_image), then grips and pulls it outward; increasing drawer extension is visible in frames 94–118 in image and left_ego_image. The robot releases the handle and withdraws (frames 119–130, wrist_image), leaving the drawer visibly open through frame 142 in image and left_ego_image. No failed acquisition, harmful collision, or unintended object displacement is established.
